signature.name: VTask.restrict
signature.type: {X : Type u_2} -> {K : Type u_8} -> [Semifield K] -> [LinearOrder K] -> [IsStrictOrderedRing K] -> (w : Convexity.StdSimplex K X) -> (s : Set X) -> (hs : ∃ x ∈ s, w.weights x ≠ 0) -> Convexity.StdSimplex K X

conventions.statement: For any vertex x ∉ s, (w.restrict s hs).weights x = 0, because the filter removes all such vertices before normalisation.
conventions.note: This follows from the filter operation: weights are zeroed outside s.

conventions.statement: The weights of the restricted point are the weights of w on s scaled by the reciprocal of their sum, so that the total is exactly 1.
conventions.note: The existence condition hs ensures the sum is nonzero, making the reciprocal well-defined.
